title: Greetings & Introductions
description: Everyday phrases for saying hello, introducing yourself and reacting politely in Brazil.

phrases.note: The most common casual greeting; 'tudo bem?' works as both 'how are you?' and 'all good?'.

phrases.pt: Meu nome é Ana. E o seu?
phrases.en: My name is Ana. And yours?
phrases.ipa: mew ˈno.mi ɛ ˈɐ.nɐ i u sew
phrases.literal: My name is Ana. And the yours?

phrases.pt: Até logo! A gente se vê.
phrases.en: See you soon! See you around.
phrases.ipa: aˈtɛ ˈlo.gu a ˈʒẽ.tʃi si ve
phrases.note: 'A gente se vê' is a very natural, friendly way to say goodbye.

phrases.en: Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
